negotiation.heading: Compare your quotes
negotiation.intro: We read the terms in each quote and put them side by side. Nothing is sent to a seller unless you press Send.
negotiation.tableCaption: Quotes received, compared on delivered price per unit
negotiation.incomplete: Incomplete: {what} not stated, so the real cost may be higher.
negotiation.reviewNote: The assistant was not fully sure about some terms. Please read the notes in each quote.
negotiation.noQuotes: No quotes yet. When sellers send quotes, they appear here side by side.
negotiation.boundsHint: The assistant keeps every suggestion inside these limits. It will never suggest a price above your maximum.
negotiation.counterNotSent: Nothing has been sent. Change anything you like, then press Send.
negotiation.counterSentNote: Your counter-offer was sent to the seller as a message.
negotiation.assistantEmpty: The assistant has not done anything yet.
negotiation.log_quotes_normalised: Read the delivery, GST and payment terms in {n} quotes. Nothing was sent.
negotiation.log_counter_proposed: Suggested a counter-offer of {price} per unit. Nothing was sent.
negotiation.log_counter_sent: You sent a counter-offer of {price} per unit.
negotiation.log_counter_discarded: You discarded a suggested counter-offer. Nothing was sent.
negotiation.log_counter_bounds_rejected: A suggestion outside your limits was discarded.
negotiation.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
negotiation.scrollHint: Scroll sideways to see all columns.
